_comment: Custody manifest for REKEYED address-keyed side tables (#8174).
One entry per `visit_metadata_*` call site, keyed `<file>::<enclosing fn>`.
Enforced by scripts/gc_rekeyed_key_tables.py: an unclassified site FAILS, and
so does an entry that matches no site -- a fix must delete its own exemption.
`open_gap` verdicts are capped by MAX_OPEN_GAPS in that script and may only go down.

sites.why: Registered prune retains on !is_dead_owner over the array owner address (array/header.rs:352).

Dropped by finalize_collected_dead_buffer (buffer/header.rs:772) off collect_dead_registered_buffers_post_trace; buffers are arena_alloc_gc_old + TENURED (buffer/header.rs:593-600), so a copying minor never forwards one.
#8190: registered prune retains on !is_dead_owner over the console instance object address (builtins/console.rs).
#8191: registered prune retains on !is_dead_owner over the wrapper ObjectHeader address (builtins/formatting/boxed_primitives.rs).
All three tables are retained on the GC_TYPE_CLOSURE-narrowed predicate in one prune (closure/dynamic_props.rs:206-214).
Registered prune retains on the FileHandle object owner (fs/mod.rs:131); the id-keyed DIR_REGISTRY is deliberately excluded and is not an address key.

The same scanner marks the identical StringHeader addresses eight lines earlier through PARSE_KEY_CACHE (visit_tagged_raw_const_ptr_slot with STRING_TAG, json/mod.rs:554-557); the ring is a strict subset, and every cache clear is paired with clear_parse_key_ring.
Registered prune retains on !is_dead_owner over the iterator array address (map.rs:54).

The Symbol arm's bits are marked as state.name by visit_nanbox_f64_slot (node_submodules/mod.rs:1509); every DIAG_CHANNEL_BY_KEY insert is paired with a DIAG_CHANNELS insert and eviction removes both (diagnostics.rs:924-996).
One registered prune retains all three tables on !is_dead_owner (node_vm.rs:1420-1434).
Registered prune retains on !is_dead_owner over the arguments-object owner (object/arguments.rs:79-86).

The #8168 fix: retains on the GC_TYPE_CLOSURE-narrowed predicate over the POINTER_TAG'd closure address (class_registry/gc_roots.rs:530). This helper is the rekey path for both scan_function_class_id_keys_mut and its budgeted twin.
Registered prune retains both maps on !is_dead_owner (object/descriptor_state.rs:1035-1055); handle-band ids in the same maps are skipped by the probe as unattributable.
Cleared per dead object by gc_type_clear_dead_payload_side_tables (gc/types.rs:799) from the sweep (gc/oldgen.rs:700, 924, 1573), outside the dead_owner fan-out.
#8192: registered prune drops the whole cache entry when either weak half (prev_keys keys-array, key_ptr interned string) is dead; next_keys is a strong root and cannot be.
Registered prune drops descriptors whose keys_array is dead and retains inner.indices on the same predicate, then rebuilds the reverse indices (object/shapes.rs:966-985).

The recorded address is the shared shape keys_array that scan_shape_cache_roots_mut strongly marks with visit_raw_mut_ptr_slot (object/mod.rs:1041); it is also allocated longlived (object/alloc.rs:753) so it never sits in a copying from-space.

The same scanner strongly marks the fulfill/reject thunks (visit_raw_mut_ptr_slot, async_step.rs:850-851) whose capture slot 0 IS the key closure (async_step.rs:881-884), and closure captures are traced and rewritten by trace_closure.

Sweep path via the PromiseCleanup finalize hook (gc/types.rs:835-838 -> promise/mod.rs:1024); copying path via cleanup_copied_minor_all_states_for_gc (promise/mod.rs:1087), which validates obj_type == GC_TYPE_PROMISE before trusting FORWARDED.
Sweep path from promise/mod.rs:1023 and copying path via cleanup_copied_minor_overflow_reactions_for_gc (promise/mod.rs:1086), both keyed on a validated promise header.
Sweep path from promise/mod.rs:1022 and copying path via cleanup_copied_minor_settle_listeners_for_gc (promise/mod.rs:1085), both keyed on a validated promise header.
Budgeted twin of scan_promise_all_states_mut on the same PromiseKeyedTable, with the same two prune paths.
Budgeted twin of the scanners.rs:100 site on the same store; sweep path promise/mod.rs:1005-1012, copying path promise/mod.rs:1069-1084.
Budgeted twin of scan_promise_overflow_reactions_mut on the same PromiseKeyedTable, with the same two prune paths.

Sweep path via the PromiseCleanup finalize hook (gc/types.rs -> promise/mod.rs clear_promise_context) and copying path via cleanup_copied_minor_promise_contexts_for_gc. #8193 deleted this function's other metadata key, ASYNC_STEP_GUARD.last_closure, which nothing read.
Budgeted twin of scan_promise_settle_listeners_mut on the same PromiseKeyedTable, with the same two prune paths.
